name: trpg-log-copilot
title_zh: 跑团桌旁帮你车卡归档线索的副官，防超游
tagline_zh: 跑到第十次团，线索、NPC 和 SAN 值散在十份记录对不上。它把表写进 Markdown，检索交给 SQLite。
tagline_en: Ten sessions in, your clues, NPCs and sanity totals sit in ten files that no longer agree. This writes tables into Markdown, hands querying to a local SQLite, and keeps dice and dashboard on your machine.
desc_en: CodeBuddy SKILL — TRPG 跑团副官：车卡、日志归档、线索分析、防超游。支持 CoC/DND 多规则，零依赖即用。
why_zh: 写入只追加 Markdown、查询只走 SQL，写坏一行只坏一行——为的是不像 JSON 那样整份报废。
why_en: Writes append to Markdown, reads go through SQL, so one bad row stays one bad row — unlike a JSON blob, which dies whole.
limit_zh: 名字是它唯一的跨文件索引键，写简称或错一个字就断联，NPC 和线索接不上。它是玩家侧的副官，不主持、不替角色做决定，想找人开团的别装。跑起来要 Python 和 SQLite，还得先用内置模板生成一份项目级规则再用。
limit_en: Names are its only cross-file index key: a nickname or one wrong character breaks the link and NPCs stop matching their clues. It sits on the player's side of the table — it does not run the game or decide for your character, so it is no use if you wanted a Keeper. Running it needs Python and SQLite, plus one setup pass to generate the project-level rule from its template.
title_en: TRPG copilot: sheets, logs, clues, anti-metagame
